Below is the plan for each class day. The {{< fa book >}} icon links to the relevant chapter of the online class book and the {{< fa person-chalkboard >}} icon to that day's slides. The **Assessment** column flags the graded events --- quizzes, simulations, the midterm, and homework due dates (the {{< fa pen >}} icon links to the homework). A blank Assessment cell is a regular discussion day.

Most class days are **Q&A** days: a randomly drawn panel discusses the reading while the rest of the class asks questions. **Simulation** days replace discussion with an in-class game and a debrief, and a few days open with a short auto-graded **quiz**. Check-in, the panel draw, quizzes, and the question queue all run through our class platform (Commons).

The schedule is provisional --- topics, readings, and the exact placement of quizzes and simulations may shift as the term unfolds.
